pairs.subject: translation-pipeline-topology
pairs.evidence: packages/kernel/py/job.py:7 These modules are the Python side of the SQLite kernel protocols (jobs, lease, ledger, meter, styles), and 'languages' here means Python and Node, not human locales; a grep of packages/kernel (py and src) for i18n, hreflang, pseudoloc and gettext found nothing, so there is no translated content, catalog or pipeline for the subject to govern.

pairs.subject: translation-pipeline-topology
pairs.evidence: lib/articles/mediumPackage.ts:259 The Medium package and the registry landing ship each post in one fixed language (lang="en"), with no translated variants, derived store or canonical fallback; a grep of lib/articles for translation, i18n, hreflang and pseudoloc found nothing (the only 'localization' hit is a tag string inside the dry stand-in fixture post).

pairs.subject: translation-pipeline-topology
pairs.evidence: app/_landing/cosmos/engine/layout.ts:351 The cosmos engine paints paper and raster layers and touches locale only once, to hard-pin number formatting to en-US; it holds no translatable strings, catalog or serving path, and a grep of app/_landing for translation, i18n, hreflang and pseudoloc found nothing (the 'translate' hits are CSS and canvas transforms).

pairs.subject: translation-pipeline-topology
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/contract.ts:5 The part port only loads, edits, undoes and prices part views (scripts, research, scenes) from kernel records, and none of these carries a language field or translated variant; a grep of app/(studio)/projects for translation, i18n, hreflang and pseudoloc found nothing, and neither did a grep of _part for language or lang.

pairs.subject: translation-pipeline-topology
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/_port/contract.ts:6 The projects port serves project lists, choices, launches and re-routes as kernel and producer records with no locale dimension; a grep of app/(studio)/projects for translation, i18n, hreflang and pseudoloc found nothing (the word 'catalog' here means @gt/catalog recipes, not a string catalog).
